headline: the encoder switch is a single config change (drop text_encoder from offload components), and the pinned-memory blocker was a model error I introduced
log_evidence: layerwise offload is enabled for both text_encoder (77 blocks across 2 stacks) and the DiT
my_error: I modelled pinned need as 125 GB for both components, but layerwise offload keeps only one block (about 0.82 GB) in the pinned buffer at a time, so the pinned limit was never the constraint
real_switch: set diffusion_offload_config.components to [dit]; DEFAULT_OFFLOAD_COMPONENTS is already {dit}, and the non-offload path uses load_to_device with the comment Keep Qwen resident
projected: encoder per request 3.14 s to about 0.5 s, meeting the under-2s target with no maths change
only_real_risk: whether encoder resident 7.33 GiB per rank plus the DiT layerwise blocks exceeds 32 GiB; the earlier 18.97 GiB figure used a DiT peak measured without a resident encoder, so it needs measurement
self_corrections: R199 derived quantity treated as free
R202 residency window useless because N=1
R203/R204 pinned need overstated by about 100x
decisions_needed: decide the FP32 guard criterion form
